messages:
nina_oncall: FYI getting a P99 SLO burn alert for hosted-infer in eu-west1, spike of 5xx/timeouts since ~06:10 UTC. Probe vs real-user gap looks large. pulling traces now. :rotating_light:

sam_sre: On it. any customer hits or support tickets?

tess_support: Yep — two customers filed support tickets about 502s and a timeout error in the last 12m. forwarding examples.

mike_obs: Dashboard snapshot -> /d/hosted-infer/timeout-triage?orgId=1 time range 06:00-06:20 shows p99 jump to ~4.6s, 5xx fraction up from 0.2% -> 3.4%.

nina_oncall: Log query I ran (logs-prod):
```
service:inference-gateway env:prod region:eu-west1 status:[500 TO 599] | count() by trace_id, status | sort by _count desc | limit 50
```
Most 5xx are 504/502, a few 500. trace links are sparse.

sam_sre: Can you paste one trace link? need to see where tracedropped.

tess_support: example trace: https://traces.internal/trace/ABc123def — note sampler shows lost spans around gateway->kv-cache call.

mike_obs: Looks like high trace-sampling drop earlier — our trace coverage drops from 85% -> 40% during the window. that explains missing spans.

sam_sre: Could be a short-lived sidecar restart or logging pipeline lag. infra-bot, any infra deploys around 06:05-06:12 UTC?

infra-bot: deploy-bot reported a rollout: hosted-infer/edge-proxy v2.9.1 -> v2.9.2 started at 06:03 UTC, completed 06:09 UTC. No rollbacks.

sam_sre: That aligns. Did the rollout change connection pool or keepalive settings?

mike_obs: Config diff shows keepalive_idle lowered from 90s -> 15s in v2.9.2. That can cause backend handshake resets under long-lived KV cache ops.

nina_oncall: We have a customer repro that reliably hits a 1-shot tail when client sends long-context requests. suggests handshake/keepalive race.

tess_support: customer provided curl + auth token and request id if you need it (shared in support ticket).

sam_sre: Quick mitigation: rolling revert of v2.9.2 to v2.9.1 in eu-west1, and temporarily increase client timeouts on gateway to 12s. I'll kick it off.

infra-bot: Started rollback of hosted-infer/edge-proxy in eu-west1 at 06:22 UTC.

mike_obs: Adding alert suppression for churn noise during rollback window, and bumping trace sampling from 20%->50% for 15m to capture more spans.

nina_oncall: After rollback p99 dropped back to ~0.9s and 5xx fraction decreased, support tickets are reporting reduced errors.

tess_support: Customers confirm fewer errors now. thank you. :heart:

sam_sre: Follow-ups: (1) revert patch in staging and add integration test for keepalive with long KV cache flows, (2) run a canary with gradual connection pool warmup, (3) restore default keepalive to 90s or parameterize per-backend.

mike_obs: I'll open a dashboard panel to surface trace-coverage and last-deploy per-region next to the SLO panel. query to reproduce: `sum:requests.filter(status>=500).by(region).rollup(1m)`

nina_oncall: Filing a post-incident note and linking the support tickets. thanks everyone.

deploy-bot: Rollback completed: hosted-infer/edge-proxy eu-west1 at 06:29 UTC. change-id: rb-2026-655.

sam_sre: Closing the thread unless new errors surface. tagging @tess_support to follow the customer patch path. :thumbsup:
